Everything due this week? Sol and the Narrator make it doable with five things: sort it into what you control, what you can influence and what you have to accept, take a few slow breaths, pick the one thing that matters most, have a backup plan, and let your first try be messy. Ignite's free Resilience & Stress-Management course teaches all of this and more.
